description: Instantly make a finished website in the person's own WeInc account from one of WeInc's ready-made designs, personalised with their business name and details. Takes about a second and returns the editor link where they can see it, change anything and publish. A few general sections (such as service highlights) are placeholder text for the person to edit. Can be called with only the business name; other details are optional and the person can change anything afterwards. Pass `template_id` from find_templates, or leave it out and give `business_type` and/or `description` so the best design is picked. Only pass details the person actually gave; never invent a phone number, email or city. The new site is not published; offer publish_website afterwards if the person wants it live.

business_name.description: The business name, exactly as the person gave it.

business_type.description: What the business is, e.g. 'bakery' or 'plumber'.

city.description: Town or city it serves, if given.

description.description: A sentence or two about the business, in the person's words.

name: create_website_from_template
title: Create website from template
